source.policy: Reference taxonomy, aliases, example counts and interaction concepts. Do not copy third-party screenshots, brand expression, proprietary code or exact compositions. Follow each originating design system's license before code reuse.

components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Progressively reveal or hide related content in vertically grouped sections.

components.name: Alert
components.purpose: Present important status, feedback or system information prominently.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Represent a person or account with an image, initials or fallback identity.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Attach compact status, property or metadata to another object.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.purpose: Show a page's position inside a navigation hierarchy.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Trigger an action such as submission, command execution or interface change.

components.name: Button group
components.purpose: Group related actions or controls into a coherent control set.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Contain information and actions belonging to one entity or concept.

components.name: Carousel
components.purpose: Browse multiple panels or media items within a bounded viewport.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Represent a binary option or multiple selections from a set.

components.name: Color picker
components.purpose: Select or edit a color value.

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: Choose from options while allowing typed filtering or search.

components.name: Date input
components.purpose: Enter a date through structured date fields.

components.name: Datepicker
components.purpose: Choose a date through a calendar-oriented interface.

components.name: Drawer
components.purpose: Reveal contextual content or controls from a screen edge.

components.name: Dropdown menu
components.purpose: Reveal actions or navigation options from a trigger without acting as a form value selector.

components.name: Empty state
components.purpose: Explain why no content is present and provide a useful recovery or next action.

components.name: Fieldset
components.purpose: Semantically group related form controls under a shared legend or context.

components.name: File
components.purpose: Represent a downloadable or attached file and its metadata/actions.

components.name: File upload
components.purpose: Allow users to choose and submit files from their device.

components.name: Footer
components.purpose: Provide persistent legal, supporting navigation or related information at the end of a page or section.

components.name: Form
components.purpose: Collect, validate and submit structured user input.

components.name: Header
components.purpose: Provide top-level identity, navigation and primary utilities.

components.name: Heading
components.purpose: Introduce and structure sections with semantic hierarchy.

components.name: Hero
components.purpose: Communicate the primary offer, context and action at a page's beginning.

components.name: Icon
components.purpose: Represent an action, object, state or concept compactly.

components.name: Image
components.purpose: Display visual media with appropriate semantics, sizing and fallback behavior.

components.name: Label
components.purpose: Give a persistent accessible name to an input or control.

components.name: Link
components.purpose: Navigate to another resource, route or location.

components.name: List
components.purpose: Group related items with ordered, unordered or descriptive semantics.

components.name: Modal
components.purpose: Interrupt the current context with a focused dialog requiring user attention or action.

components.name: Navigation
components.purpose: Organize links for moving between pages, views or page sections.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Navigate a large result set divided into discrete pages.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Show interactive contextual content anchored to another element.

components.name: Progress bar
components.purpose: Show continuous progress toward completion.

components.name: Progress indicator
components.purpose: Show progress through discrete stages or steps.

components.name: Quote
components.purpose: Present attributed quotation or emphasized quoted content.

components.name: Radio button
components.purpose: Choose exactly one option from a predefined set.

components.name: Rating
components.purpose: Display or capture a rating value, commonly through stars or another bounded scale.

components.name: Rich text editor
components.purpose: Edit formatted text through direct manipulation or markup controls.

components.name: Search input
components.purpose: Find or filter content by a user-entered query.

components.name: Segmented control
components.purpose: Switch among a small set of mutually exclusive modes or views.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Choose one or more predefined form values from a collapsible option list.

components.name: Separator
components.purpose: Visually and semantically divide related regions.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Reserve layout and communicate pending content loading.

components.name: Skip link
components.purpose: Let keyboard users bypass repeated content and jump to a meaningful region.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Select a numeric value or range along a bounded continuum.

components.name: Spinner
components.purpose: Communicate indeterminate background activity.

components.name: Stack
components.purpose: Apply consistent spacing and direction to a sequence of child elements.

components.name: Stepper
components.purpose: Increment or decrement a numeric value through explicit controls.

components.name: Table
components.purpose: Display structured data in rows and columns, optionally with sorting, selection and filtering.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Switch between related content panels while preserving a compact page structure.

components.name: Text input
components.purpose: Capture a single line of text.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: Capture multi-line text.

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Provide transient layered feedback without blocking the primary task.

components.name: Toggle
components.purpose: Change a binary state or setting.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Provide concise supplementary information about a control or element without becoming the primary interaction surface.

components.name: Tree view
components.purpose: Navigate or inspect nested hierarchical information.

components.name: Video
components.purpose: Present video with accessible playback controls and fallback behavior.

components.name: Visually hidden
components.purpose: Provide assistive-technology context without visually displaying the text.
